title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry’s transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world’s trade is carried by sea? We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services‑together. Are you ready to jump onboard?Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonise the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsila’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.Senior Legal CounselMain responsibilities- Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.- Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.- Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.- Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.- Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.- Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.- Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.- Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.- Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.Required qualifications- Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.- Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practising attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.- Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English;
ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.- Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.Preferred experience- Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors.- Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions, especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.- Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties, state‑owned entities, or other regulated counterparties.- Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance.- Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.What success looks like in this role- Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.- Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.- Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.- Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities;
everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job‑relevant merits and abilities.Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Our team of 18,300 professionals, in more than 230 locations in 77 countries, shape the decarbonisation transformation of our industries across the globe. Read more on

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. - Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Parceiro De Vendas
description:
Seja um Parceiro Estratégico do Grupo AG Capital, a Primeira TaxTech do Brasil. Você é um consultor, comercial ou líder de negócios com acesso a decisores C-level? Quer oferecer aos seus clientes uma solução de alto impacto, sem custo inicial, e ainda gerar uma nova e significativa fonte de receita? O Grupo AG Capital, a primeira e maior TaxTech do Brasil, está expandindo sua rede de Parceiros Estratégicos. Já recuperamos mais de R$ 8 bilhões em tributos para mais de 12.000 clientes, incluindo 15% das empresas listadas na B3, e queremos que você faça parte desta história de sucesso. Nossa missão é transformar a complexidade tributária brasileira em fluxo de caixa e compliance para as empresas, através de tecnologia proprietária e uma metodologia exclusiva. Para acelerar essa missão, buscamos parceiros que compartilhem da nossa visão e queiram crescer conosco. Quem Buscamos? O Parceiro Ideal em 3 Dimensões: 1) Expertise e Acesso a Clientes Estratégicos: Você é um especialista com reputação sólida em consultoria (contábil, tributária, RH), advocacia empresarial, tecnologia ou vendas;
Possui um relacionamento de confiança com CFOs, CHROs e CEOs de médias e grandes empresas, especialmente as de Lucro Presumido ou Real? Buscamos sua credibilidade e seu acesso ao mercado. 2) Alinhamento com um Modelo de Negócio Inovador: Você acredita em um modelo onde o cliente só paga pelo sucesso, sem custos de entrada ou taxas de manutenção? Nosso modelo de remuneração 100% no êxito é um dos nossos maiores diferenciais. Buscamos parceiros que saibam comunicar o poder de uma proposta de valor de risco zero. 3) Mentalidade\ "TaxTech\" Você vê a tecnologia como o futuro da gestão fiscal? Com nossa plataforma proprietária Athena™, analisamos 100% dos dados fiscais sem amostragem, garantindo precisão e escala incomparáveis. Buscamos parceiros que queiram liderar a transformação digital no setor tributário. O que Oferecemos à sua Parceria: - Portfólio de Alto Valor: Adicione as soluções AG, AG Tax e Agnes ao seu portfólio e resolva dores latentes de seus clientes.
- Modelo de Receita Atrativo: Gere uma nova e robusta linha de receita, 100% comissionada sobre o sucesso das operações, sem limite de ganhos.
- Força da Marca Líder: Associe-se à marca que é referência no mercado, com metodologia validada, operação segurada pela Berkley e reconhecimento pela mídia e por grandes premiações (Exame, Deloitte, BTG Pactual).
- Diferencial Competitivo: Ofereça aos seus clientes uma solução inovadora que a concorrência não possui, fortalecendo seu próprio posicionamento como consultor estratégico. Você se identifica com este perfil? Se você é um profissional visionário, com uma carteira de clientes consolidada e o desejo de gerar um impacto financeiro real para seus clientes e para o seu negócio, queremos conversar com você. Clique no link para saber mais e iniciar sua jornada como Parceiro Estratégico do Grupo AG Capital. #AGCapital #ParceriaEstrategica #TaxTech #ConsultoriaTributaria #Consultoria #AdvocaciaEmpresarial #RecuperacaoTributaria #InovacaoFiscal #Finanças #Contabilidade #eSocial #LucroReal#Vendas

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description: JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company. The Role As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription. Please share your resume in English. Responsibilities: Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage. Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes. Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits. Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources. Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams. Requirements: A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines. Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred. Fluent communication skills English. Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.E. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology. Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building. Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred. Why Join JoVE? You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market. You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education. Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Especialista Em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas. O que Buscamos? O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework. ✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura - Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design - Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage - Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS) - Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos - Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering Azure Files - Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS) - Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory - Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso - Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises - Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup Azure Networking – Conceitos principais - Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP - Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall - Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute - Private Endpoints e service endpoints - Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure ✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações - Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking - Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher - Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros - Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede Logs e análises - Integração com Log Analytics Workspace - Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL) - Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura - Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais ✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios - Diferenciais Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure. Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design. Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento. title: Global Networks Leader
description: Purpose As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT USSyniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLEWe are seeking a highly technical and execution‐driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll DoProduct Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP.Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior.Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKESThe Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams.The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key SkillsVisionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic.Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values:Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFERTrust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSIONAt Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Head Of Legal
description:

We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive;
the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page hereAbout the RoleWe are looking for a Head of Legal to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business in a highly complex, science-, operations- and contract-based environment. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets, requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. investor relations from a legal standpoint- Build scalable legal processes, templates, and infrastructureYou can be a Rock-Star if you haveCore Skills & Experience- Law degree with active OAB ideally from a startup angle- Due diligence (legal & regulatory)- Complex contract structuring and negotiation- International contracts and cross-border operations- Strong background in business-oriented legal roles (e.G., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas)- Solid experience with:- Corporate law and governance- Investor relations and strategic partnerships- Fluency in English, with experience working in international environmentsKey Qualities- Business-oriented mindset: understands legal as a driver of growth- Highly relational: strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions- Strategic thinker: connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks- Pragmatic and solution-driven: balances risk with execution speed- High ownership: comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure- Strong institutional presence: capable of representing the company externally- Structured and integrative: able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains- Neutral and sound judgment, especially in complex or sensitive mattersBonus Points (but not essential)- Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets- Background in startups, scale-ups, or boutique law firms- Exposure to governance and international structures- Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.)- Business and legal experience in Germany- Speaks German- Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SPLiving Our ValuesAt InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. title: Técnico De Serviços Em Maritimo
description:
Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito. A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Rio para Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês. Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo: Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado. Tipos de equipamentos atendidos: - Radares - ECDIS - Satcoms - Rádios HF e VHF - GPS - Girobússola - Pilotos automáticos - Sirenes Qualificações do Técnico em Marítima: - Mais de 3 anos como MST na indústria de transporte marítimo comercial.
- Um diploma universitário em engenharia ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.
- Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.
- Forte conhecimento de teoria e aplicação de eletrônica.
- Licença de Operador de Rádio GMDSS preferencialmente.
- Fisicamente apto. O ambiente de trabalho geralmente envolve carregar 20 quilos, subir escadas/mastros, trabalhar em espaços confinados e exposição ao clima. Os candidatos devem estar legalmente autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil.

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation. Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations. Who We Are Looking For We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain, a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution). This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts. If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply. - Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
- Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

- Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies. Solution Design, Implementation & Testing - Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
- Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
- Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
- Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
- Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
- Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
- Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
- Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption. Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%) - Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
- Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
- Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices. Must Have - Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
- Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
- Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Availability to travel.
- Legally authorized to work in Brazil. What We Offer - Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
- A collaborative and international work environment.
- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects. Why Hoist? If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Analista Administrativo De Obras
description:
A Baggio e Carvalho Engenharia é uma empresa de médio porte, especializada em gestão e execução de obras comerciais e residenciais desde 1986. A empresa vem em um ritmo de crescimento interessante nos últimos anos e está buscando pessoas para somar e crescer com ela. Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Administrativo de Obra (Financeiro) para atuar em nossa obra, um projeto com alto volume de controle e exigência de detalhamento junto ao cliente. Procuramos alguém dinâmico(a), organizado(a) e com atenção aos detalhes, contribuindo para a eficiência dos processos administrativos e financeiros da obra. Principais atividades da função: .Controlar e manter atualizado o caixinha da obra e os reembolsos, garantindo que não haja virada de mês sem fechamento;
.Receber, conferir e lançar todas as notas fiscais da obra (APs, PPCs e PCTs) no Sienge, observando dados de faturamento, retenções e prazos de pagamento;
.Verificar se as retenções de impostos (PCC, IR, INSS) estão de acordo com o ensinado e devolver ao fornecedor quando houver divergências;
.Verificar o CNAE na nota fiscal do fornecedor, assegurando que esteja compatível com o serviço prestado;
.Conferir o endereço da obra nas notas fiscais, garantindo que esteja conforme o solicitado pelo cliente;
.Cobrar as apropriações da engenharia para lançamento das APs e controle financeiro;
.Emitir e conferir relatórios de pedidos de compra em aberto, boletins de medição e saldos de contratos, cobrando notas fiscais correspondentes;
.Controlar adiantamentos de fornecedores, solicitando NFs referentes a entregas e serviços;
.Enviar contratos para assinatura digital e realizar liberação no Sienge após conferência dos documentos;
.Lançar aditivos positivos e negativos conforme solicitação da engenharia;
.Emitir e conferir relatório “Administração de Obras”, montar RP e enviar ao financeiro corporativo com as notas e documentos exigidos pelo cliente;
.Acompanhar relatórios de distorção por apropriação e de saldos de credores, cobrando notas fiscais de fornecedores já pagos por adiantamento;
.Enviar relatório diário de notas lançadas e faturadas contra a Baggio;
.Acompanhar e garantir o envio das CNDs mensais e documentação de terceiros;
.No encerramento da obra, realizar o fechamento financeiro completo, assegurando que não existam saldos, pendências ou notas a lançar/pagar;
.Apoiar demandas administrativas e financeiras do gestor de obra e da equipe de engenharia. Pré-requisitos: .Formação completa em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas afins;
.Experiência anteriorem rotinas administrativas e financeiras de obra;
.Excel intermediário ou avançado;
.Perfil proativo, sistemático e detalhista, com boa capacidade de organização;
.Facilidade decomunicação e comprometimento com prazos e qualidade das entregas. Desejável: .Conhecimento em Sienge;
.Experiência em obrascom múltiplos CNPJs e contratos diferenciados;
.Conhecimento em processos de medição e apropriação de custos;
.Vivência em relacionamento direto com clientes corporativos e processos de auditoria financeira. Outras informações: .Regime: CLT .Carga Horária: 44 horas semanais - Presencial (segunda a sexta-feira) .Local: Zona Sul do Rio de Janeiro .Benefícios: vale assiduidade, plano de saúde e odontológico, vale-refeição e vale-transporte

title: Client Services Associate
description:

You'll be the voice of Clearlight Insights to prospective and existing clients - reaching out, building relationships, attending and facilitating client meetings, and supporting account management activities that keep our partnerships running smoothly.You don't need years of experience - you need sharp communication skills, a proactive mindset, and a genuine interest in market research and consulting. All work is conducted in English with a global client base.WHAT YOU'LL DO- Identify and reach out to prospective clients via email and LinkedIn to generate new business conversations- Draft and send tailored outreach messages that represent Clearlight Insights professionally and compellingly- Schedule, coordinate, and attend client meetings - preparing agendas, taking notes, and ensuring clear follow-through on next steps- Participate actively in calls and video meetings with clients, building rapport and representing the agency confidently- Support account management activities - following up on ongoing projects, maintaining client records, and ensuring client satisfaction- Track outreach activity, pipeline, and meeting outcomes using CRM tools- Collaborate with the research delivery team to ensure client briefs are well understood and acted upon- Help identify opportunities to grow existing client accountsWHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR- A recent graduate or early-career professional with 0–2 years of experience - degrees or postgraduate qualifications in business, marketing, market research, social sciences, or a related field are a plus- Fluent English - written and spoken - is a hard requirement;
all client communication, meetings, and internal collaboration are conducted in English- Excellent communicator - confident, professional, and personable;
comfortable holding your own in video meetings with senior international stakeholders- Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to juggle multiple client threads and follow-ups at once- Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a fully remote setup- Comfortable working across time zones - some overlap with US and European business hours will be required- Familiarity with LinkedIn, email outreach, and basic CRM tools is a bonus but not required- An interest in or exposure to market research, consulting, or B2B services is highly desirableWHAT WE OFFER- Competitive salary of R$120k–155k per year- Permanent, full-time role with genuine long-term growth prospects- Fully remote - work from anywhere in Brazil- Real client exposure from day one - this is not a back-office role- A collaborative, international team with a flat structure and direct access to senior leadership- A strong foundation for a career in client services, business development, or research consultingIf you're ambitious, articulate, and eager to grow in a fast-paced research environment, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV and a brief note (feel free to add a cover letter!) on why this role interests you.

A área de Customer Success é responsável por garantir que nossos clientes tenham a melhor experiência possível com nossos produtos e serviços, alcançando seus objetivos e extraindo o máximo valor da nossa solução.Aqui, atuamos de forma proativa, construindo relacionamentos de confiança, acompanhando a jornada do cliente e sendo parceiros estratégicos em cada etapa. Nosso foco é impulsionar resultados, promover engajamento e garantir a retenção e expansão da base de clientes.Somos uma equipe colaborativa, orientada por dados, apaixonada por resolver problemas e comprometida com o sucesso do cliente — porque o sucesso deles é o nosso sucesso também.Descrição da vaga:· Apoiar o cliente: Garantir que os clientes recebam o apoio necessário para o sucesso com nossos produtos ou serviços;
· Onboarding: Conduzir o processo de onboarding de novos clientes, assegurando que a transição seja tranquila e eficiente. Gerenciando a agendas e monitorando os prazos entre etapas;
· Relacionamento contínuo: Manter contato regular com os clientes via WhatsApp para garantir que suas necessidades sejam atendidas e que as expectativas sejam superadas;
· Identificação de oportunidades de vendas: Identificar oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell com base nas necessidades dos clientes;
· Resolução de problemas: Atuar como ponto de contato para resolver problemas ou preocupações dos clientes de forma eficiente e com empatia;
· Feedback ao produto: Coletar feedback dos clientes e compartilhar insights com as equipes internas para melhorias no produto ou serviço;
Relatórios: Elaborar relatórios sobre o evento do cliente que irão nortear a execução final do evento.RequisitosBoa comunicação: Excelente capacidade de comunicação verbal e escrita, com foco em escuta ativa e empatia.Orientação para resultados: Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e orientada a resultados, com foco na satisfação e sucesso do cliente.Proatividade: Ser capaz de identificar problemas antes que eles se tornem críticos e propor soluções eficazes.Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM (como Salesforce, HubSpot) e outras plataformas de suporte ao cliente.Experiência de pelo menos 2 anos como analista de CS ou atendimento ao clienteVivência com gestão de carteira de clientes (B2B ou B2C).Experiência com onboarding, retenção e expansão de contas.Ter conhecimento no mercado de eventos (diferencial).

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.Role Overview:We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!What does day-to-day look like:You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.Requirements:Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skillsFeedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.Preferred Qualifications:Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.Perks of Freelancing With Turing:Work in a fully remote environment.Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.Offer Details:Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. Por isso também, estamos entre as Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar do Varejo, segundo o ranking da GPTW. Ficou com vontade de fazer parte desse time? Uma coisa a gente garante: o que não falta por aqui é ‘Paixão pelo que fazemos ’, e você vai sentir isso em cada etapa do nosso negócio, na entrega e na dedicação de todas as nossas pessoas. Simplesmente, porque Ser Assaí é Assim. #VEMSERASSAÍ você também!

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do. We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives. You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you'll be doing Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil What you'll need 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems Great organisational and time management skills Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks Solid analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Fluency in English Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates: Job scams are on the rise. title: Service Manager
description: At OSF Digital, we are looking for a dynamic and proactive Service Manager to lead and optimize IT service delivery operations. Responsibilities: Develop and implement service management strategies and plans to ensure high-quality service delivery. Oversee service delivery teams, providing leadership, guidance, and performance support. Monitor and manage SLAs and KPIs, ensuring agreed targets are consistently met or exceeded. Analyze service performance metrics and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Manage and resolve service-related issues and escalations in a timely and effective manner. Act as the primary point of contact for clients regarding service delivery matters. Collaborate with project managers, technical teams, and stakeholders to align service operations with company goals. Prepare and present service performance reports to senior management and clients. Contribute to the evolution of service management practices, tools, and processes. Requirements: Proven experience as a Service Manager or in a similar IT service delivery role. Strong experience managing SLAs, KPIs, and service management strategies. Solid leadership and team management skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in service management tools and structured operational processes. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. ITIL certification or equivalent service management qualification is highly desirable. Fluency in English and Portuguese is required. Benefits: Discover OSF’s benefits and programs!

title: Vaga:Psicólogo Clínico Trainee | Clínica Ft
description: Processo Seletivo | Psicólogo Clínico Trainee | Clínica FTDescrição da vagaA Clínica Flávio Torrecillas nasceu de uma convicção simples: a psicologia formou muitos profissionais para atender, mas poucos para sustentar clínica, postura, carreira e independência no mundo real. Durante anos, vimos de perto o mesmo padrão se repetir: psicólogos tecnicamente bons, mas inseguros na condução clínica, frágeis na construção da própria carreira e presos a um modelo de profissão que cobra muito, devolve pouco e quase sempre empurra o profissional para o improviso. Foi por isso que a Clínica FT decidiu construir a formação e a oportunidade que eu queria ter tido : um modelo diferente e mais real. Mais do que uma clínica, desenvolvemos um ambiente de formação aplicada para psicólogos que desejam crescer com profundidade, supervisão, direção e responsabilidade. Aqui, o profissional não entra apenas para atender. Ele entra para aprender a sustentar uma prática clínica mais madura, mais estruturada e mais coerente com a realidade da profissão.Nosso modelo combina atendimento real, supervisão clínica, mentoria profissional e desenvolvimento de visão de carreira. Acreditamos que psicólogo não deve ser formado apenas para sobreviver de sessão em sessão, mas para construir presença, clareza, valor e autonomia ao longo do tempo.Por isso, a Clínica FT busca profissionais e futuros profissionais que queiram mais do que uma contratação. Buscamos pessoas que queiram fazer parte de uma formação viva, exigente e transformadora, dentro de uma estrutura que leva a sério tanto o cuidado com o paciente quanto a construção do psicólogo que sustenta esse cuidado. Eu vou te ensinar o passo a passo de como ser um psicólogo mais seguro para atender seus pacientes e toda a abrir as portas de toda a estrutura que trouxe ate aqui. Sobre a oportunidadeSe você está cansado de ser só mais um na psicologia, de esperar paciente cair do céu, sente vergonha de cobrar, depende de indicação ou já cansou de não ter paciente?Aqui você vai aprender tudo que ninguém te ensinou, direto com Flávio Torrecillas, eleito psicólogo destaque de MG por 3 anos consecutivos, portador do título “Gente de Expressão de MG” 30 mil atendimentos realizados e fundador da Clínica FT.Esta oportunidade foi pensada para psicólogos e estudantes em fase avançada da graduação que desejam desenvolver segurança clínica, visão de carreira e prática title: Gestora De Pacientes | Suporte Clínico Via Whatsapp
description: SOBRE A OPORTUNIDADEEstamos contratando uma Gestora de Pacientes para cuidar da comunicação contínua com as famílias que já são pacientes da Dra. Marcela Machado.Essa não é uma vaga de suporte genérico, nem de assistente virtual. É uma vaga para alguém que entende o universo da saúde, tem manejo com famílias em processo terapêutico e sabe se comunicar com empatia, clareza e responsabilidade.A clínica é especializada em TEA, TDAH e epilepsia. São mais de 750 pacientes e cada família acompanhada pela Dra. Marcela faz parte de um grupo de WhatsApp onde acontece o suporte entre consultas. Você será a pessoa responsável por esse espaço.  COMO ESSA VAGA FUNCIONA NA PRÁTICAVocê não precisa estar disponível o tempo inteiro. A atuação acontece em três janelas fixas por dia, de segunda a sexta:-   09h da manhã-   14h da tarde-   17h da tardeEm cada uma dessas janelas, você entra no WhatsApp, lê as mensagens dos grupos de pacientes e responde com base no playbook, FAQ e condutas definidas pela clínica.Dúvidas que exigem avaliação clínica? Você encaminha para a Dra. Marcela e repassa a resposta ao paciente. Simples assim.  O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER- Gerenciar os grupos de WhatsApp dos pacientes em acompanhamento- Responder dúvidas frequentes com base no playbook e FAQ da clínica- Encaminhar à Dra. Marcela as questões que exigem avaliação clínica- Garantir que nenhuma família fique sem retorno dentro das janelas de atendimento- Manter o registro das interações organizado e atualizado

title: Hr And Recruitment Specialist (Americas Timezone)

Without a functioning hiring pipeline, we cannot staff the operations, sales, and finance functions that the company needs to grow. You own that pipeline. Why LATAM?We are building a 24/7 recruitment operation. With our existing team spread across CET and APAC timezones, we need recruitment coverage in the Americas timezone (UTC-3 to UTC-5) to ensure candidates are being sourced, screened, and moved through the pipeline around the clock. Brazil and Argentina are our priority markets for this role due to strong talent pools, timezone alignment, and cultural fit with our global remote team. Day-to-day you will:Manage the full hiring pipeline for all open roles in Recruitee — from sourcing to offerWrite and post job descriptions in Recruitee (you will improve on the ones we already have)Screen CVs against role requirements — moving qualified candidates forward, rejecting unqualified ones fastConduct first-stage screening calls to assess fit, availability, and English fluencyCoordinate trial tasks with candidates and score results against the rubricOwn onboarding for every new hire: send access credentials, set up their first-week schedule, run the 30-minute orientation callTrack hiring pipeline metrics weekly: candidates screened, interviews scheduled, time-to-fill per roleReport to Michel (CEO) weekly with a pipeline updateProvide Americas-timezone recruitment coverage as part of our 24/7 hiring operation Over time: build and maintain an onboarding playbook so the process is consistent regardless of roleWhat You'll Own (KPIs)These are your KPIs. Shared upfront, reviewed every 2 weeks for the first 3 months, then monthly:Candidates screened: 20+ per week during active hiring phases Interview-to-hire ratio: 5:1 or better (5 interviews for every hire made) Time-to-fill: 21 days or less from job posting to offer accepted, per role Onboarding completion: 100% of new hires complete the onboarding checklist before their second week Weekly pipeline report: Delivered every Friday by EOD The primary metric is time-to-fill. Every day a critical role is unfilled is a day the CEO absorbs that work. Speed with quality is the target. Compensation and Terms Monthly retainer: EUR 600–800 depending on experience (competitive for LATAM market) Arrangement: Freelance / contractor — you invoice us monthly Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week Performance reviews: Every 2 weeks for the first 3 months, then monthly

title: .Net/C - React (Fullstack)
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office. Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade. Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS. Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos. Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração. Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.O que nós estamos procurando;
Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata. Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.Js, JavaScript e TypeScript. Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance. Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas. Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).O que oferecemos;
VR/VT Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!) Gympass Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!) Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!) Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;
Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

title: Desenvolvedor C Sênior
description:

inglês intermediário ouavançado (leitura de documentação e colaboração técnica). Diferenciais Experiência com MediatR, AutoMapper e FluentValidation. Familiaridade com AWS Bedrock ou outras plataformas de IA generativa. Experiência com arquiteturas multi-tenant. Vivência com CloudFormation ou Terraform para IaC. Conhecimento em processamento de documentos (PDF, Excel, OCR). Experiência com provedores de identidade federada (Azure AD, Okta, OpenID Connect). Certificação AWS (Solutions Architect, Developer ou equivalente). title: Ai Trainer
description:
AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese FluencyAbout ProlificProlific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.The roleWe’re looking for Advanced Japanese Speakers to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a Domain Expert participant, where you’ll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models.Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay $20-30/hr per AI task completed. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.What you’ll bringAdvanced language skills and verifiable experience as being fluent in Japanese.Fluency in English (B2+)A willingness to take our skills verification test to assess your suitability for our Domain Expert participant poolStrong attention to detail and the ability to concentrate on complex tasks for up to one hour at a timeA reliable and fast internet connection and access to a computerA willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employedA Paypal account to receive payment from our clientsWhat you’ll be doing in the roleCompleting AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in JapaneseJudging the performance of AI in performing Japanese promptsImproving cutting-edge AI modelsWhy Prolific is a great platform to join as a ParticipantJoining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again;
simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.Links to more information on ProlificWebsiteYoutubePrivacy StatementBy submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal personal information.

Facilitar a adoção de práticas ágeis entre as equipes, garantindo a compreensão e aplicação correta dos princípios e cerimônias. Monitorar riscos do projeto, sinalizando desvios de prazo, custo ou escopo para a gestão imediata e propor planos de ação corretivos. Garantir que a documentação funcional e técnica entregue pelo fornecedor atenda aos padrões exigidos pela governança da instituição. Articular e facilitar a interface com áreas internas parceiras, antecipando demandas e viabilizando acessos, aprovações, validações e demais trâmites necessários para assegurar a execução contínua dos projetos.
